info.name: Worldline Card Issuing Account - AccountState Statement API

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: statementId
params.description: Unique identification of the statement in which this transaction has been paid out

params.name: languageCode
params.description:
The language of the statement.

Composed of two parts, separated by an underscore.
The ISO 639-1 alpha-2 codes for languages, and the ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes for regions.

ISO 639-1 alpha-2 codes 'de', 'en', 'fi', 'fr', 'nl', 'sv'.

ISO 3166  alpha-2 codes 'de', 'fi', 'fr', 'gb', 'nl'.

params.name: statementDate
params.description: Statement creation Date (yyyy-mm-dd)

items.docs: This operation uses the unique statement id to retrieve the statement data

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: statementDateFrom
params.description: Statement search from date (yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: statementDateTo
params.description: Statement search to date (yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: statementAmountFrom
params.description: Statement amount (whole units), amount should be greater than or equal to this value

params.name: statementAmountTo
params.description: Statement amount (whole units), amount should be less than this value

params.name: statementPeriod
params.description:
Statement period code. Format <yyyy><w><weeknumber> or <yyyy><m><monthnumber>

examples
2016w04, 2016m01
